matches.rationale: No report finding covers MIN_DEPOSIT_LAMPORTS leaving out the 128-byte account storage overhead. Finding 12 is about rent on the Solana PDAs, not the Ethereum minimum deposit.
No report finding mentions the PDA bump being passed in as a user-supplied argument.
No report finding notes that MessageSent emits the Ethereum chain id as the destination. Finding 8 is about argument mapping in EtherBridge.
Finding 16 discusses the logging but not Solana's log truncation limit.
Finding 1 identifies collisions in the generateRandomNonce nonce, notes that only 64 bits are kept, and recommends keeping the full 256 bits.
No report finding covers addressArrayInitialized accepting an empty array.
Findings 2 and 3 mention the hardcoded relayer but not that it is a single custodian of bridged funds.
No report finding covers the missing _disableInitializers calls in the implementation constructors.
Finding 7 identifies invoke_signed called with empty seeds where invoke would do.
Finding 12 mentions the hardcoded 1024-byte size but treats it as a rent-exemption issue, not wasteful over-allocation.
